name: Zypento Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: sproutient

sections.description:
Zypento Wishlist for WooCommerce adds a lightweight and user-friendly wishlist feature to your WooCommerce store.

With this plugin, customers can click the heart icon on any product to instantly add it to their wishlist. They can then access their wishlist anytime from the My Account page, where they can view saved items and remove them if needed.

No complex setup, no bloated features—just a seamless wishlist experience for your customers that improves engagement and increases return visits.

Key Features:

  • Add or remove products from wishlist with a heart button on product pages and shop loops.
  • View all saved products in the dedicated Wishlist section on the My Account page.
  • Remove products from wishlist with a single click.
  • Works perfectly with WooCommerce and WordPress themes.
  • Lightweight and fast—no unnecessary bloat.

CSS/JS source

Unminified CSS/JS are in assets/css/src and assets/js/src.

GitHub

https://github.com/sproutient/Zypento-Wishlist-for-WooCommerce
Clone the repository, Then to compile css/js from source, run ‘composer install’ once and whenever you want to compile, run ‘composer create-scripts’
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder zypento-wishlist to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Done! The heart icon will appear on your products and the Wishlist section will be added to the My Account page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

Can users access their wishlist without logging in?

No, this version requires users to be logged in to save and view their wishlist.

Can I customize the heart icon or its position?

Currently, customization options are not available in the plugin settings, but you can override the templates in your theme.
